احتفين (form VIII)
# اِحْتَفَيْنَ (iḥtafayna) /iħ.ta.faj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
# اُحْتُفِينَ (uḥtufīna) /uħ.tu.fiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
# اِحْتَفِينَ (iḥtafīna) /iħ.ta.fiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
